Linux Locale Editor third-party notices

The first-party application and publishing tools are MIT-licensed; see LICENSE.

The standalone Linux executables embed Swift runtime/Foundation/libdispatch
components from Swift 6.4.1. Their upstream license texts, runtime library
exceptions, and available notices are included in the Swift/ directory.

Sources:
https://github.com/swiftlang/swift/tree/swift-6.4.1-RELEASE
https://github.com/swiftlang/swift-foundation
https://github.com/swiftlang/swift-corelibs-foundation
https://github.com/swiftlang/swift-corelibs-libdispatch

The embedded Unicode currency-symbol data and Foundation ICU data retain their
Unicode/ICU terms; see UNICODE-LICENSE.txt and the upstream runtime notices.

GTK, glibc and other system libraries are dynamically linked dependencies
provided by the Linux distribution and retain their own licenses and notices.
